appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Product Rating Share by Category'.
The chart displays circular markers for each category, with their rating share values labeled above each marker.
All markers are blue circles of uniform size and color.
The chart includes a category labeled 'Quality' with a value of 14%.
The chart includes a category labeled 'Price' with a value of 49%.
The chart includes a category labeled 'Design' with a value of 30%.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the Product Rating Share dashboard and open the product attribute follow-up item for the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
The dashboard labeled rating-share values are the evidence source for selecting the category with the strongest current customer demand signal.
The product attribute follow-up queue is reserved for the attribute category with the highest current labeled rating share.
The options for the 'Product attribute follow-up category' are 'Select Price', 'Select Support', and 'Select Design'.
